Subject: Post-demo security follow-up: SSO/SCIM & access controls next steps

Hi Anna / MedIQ security team —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can qualify the SSO/SCIM integration and the identity & access controls portion of the security review: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status: you mentioned a SOC 2 report in progress for 2027-Q2. Please confirm whether a Type II will be available and an expected date. That will help scope the inventory we need to provide.

2) Data classification & GDPR/HIPAA applicability: confirm which datasets from MedIQ will be sent to Redwood (PHI vs. pseudonymized). We can map controls accordingly.

3) IAM evidence we can provide: SSO (SAML 2.0) configuration guide, SCIM provisioning spec and sample responses, RBAC admin flow doc, and an export of admin user roles. I attached a short summary (redwood-sso-scim-summary.pdf) and an internal evidence checklist to show typical items we supply.

4) Vendor questionnaire: If you have a completed vendor security questionnaire, please send it (we can pre-fill where appropriate). If you'd prefer, we can intake Microsoft-style XLSX questionnaires — I included a blank intake template in this thread.

Proposed schedule: a focused evidence-review call (30–45 min) next week with your security admin + our infra/security eng (Karthik) to walk through the artifacts and any gaps. Are any of these slots good for you?
- Tue 6/1: 9:00–10:00 PT
- Wed 6/2: 11:00–12:00 PT
- Thu 6/3: 14:00–15:00 PT

If you prefer to ship the questionnaire first, we can review asynchronously and then do a short follow-up call to close gaps.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
